title: Editor cannot open Restore…: the one verb disabled with reason, door answers 403
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): O, cookies of seats A (owner) and B (editor), api, pq, and one browser context per seat with {locale:'en-US', colorScheme:'light', viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}}; never close pages or contexts.

S2: Pick S where pq "SELECT a.email, s.role FROM seat s JOIN account a ON a.id=s.account_id WHERE s.site_key='<S>' AND a.email IN ('<A>','<B>') ORDER BY 1" returns A as owner and B as editor (scv2 stand: scv2jo.scv2.tracy.test); otherwise BLOCKED.
S3: Run api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-004-point","notes":""}'; record M = body.version.
S4: Run api b GET /api/sites/<S>/backups and api a GET /api/sites/<S>/backups; record each body.may.

S5: Set K = 'reg004-editor-' + unix seconds; run api b POST /api/sites/<S>/restore '{"mode":"everything","version":<M>,"idemKey":"<K>","confirm":"restore"}'; then pq "select count(*) from site_operation where site_key='<S>' and idem_key='<K>'".

S6: In B's context open Site changes for S (goto O/<S>; wait URL '/s/session-' and "[contenteditable='true']"; goto with tab=tracy:changes&site=<S>; wait '.tv-activity-v2' and until '.tv-activity-v2 [data-reading]' is absent); wait for "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<M>']" (≤60 s; if absent click '.tv-activity-v2 .tv-activity-more button' up to 10 times).

S7: Click "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<M>'] button.tv-activity-event-main" until its aria-expanded is 'true'; in "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<M>'] [data-detail]" record: restoreDisabled = [data-restore='backup'].disabled (EmDash: [data-restore='content']), restoreButtons = count of [data-restore], forbidden = textContent of each [data-forbidden].
S8: Click the detail's [data-restore] with {force:true}; wait 1500 ms; record document.querySelector("[role=dialog]") === null.
S9: Click "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<M>'] .tv-moment-menu button[aria-haspopup='menu']"; record [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu] [role=menuitem]')].map(e => e.disabled); press Escape.
S10: In A's context repeat S6–S7 (no clicks on restore verbs); record restoreDisabled and the [data-forbidden] count.

S11: In A's context click the detail's [data-restore] (Everything is chosen first); wait for '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]'; record CONFIRM = [label text of '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]', document.activeElement's trimmed text, '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-everything]'.disabled]; fill it with 'Restore' and record ENABLED = !'[role=dialog] [data-confirm-everything]'.disabled; press Escape (never confirm).
expect: S7 (B): restoreDisabled == true; restoreButtons == 1 (one Restore…); WP/Joomla forbidden texts == ['Your role on this site can see backups but not put files back.', 'Only an owner or admin of this site can restore everything.'], EmDash one text (pre-fix: enabled, no [data-forbidden]).
S8: true — no restore dialog opened (pre-fix: the dialog opened and only refused after typing the site name and pressing).
S11 (A): CONFIRM deep-equals ['Type “Restore” to confirm', 'Cancel', true]; ENABLED === true (the word, not the site address, opens it).
evidence: tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/qa/r1/bugs/QA-I14.md (fix b824a4162); the QA note is Studio-local (not in git), the fix commit is on develop
fence: GET /api/sites/:key/backups returns may{restoreFiles: toolsets.code, restoreEverything: toolsets.site} from seatToolsets (apps/tracy-web/src/sites/route.js), and BackupRow.tsx disables the restore verbs with a [data-forbidden] reason; POST /restore still refuses with 403 FORBIDDEN_WRITE.
